svg.title: XENA LaaS – NettingSet Completion Signaling High-Level Flow
svg.desc: End-to-end architecture flow from Data Provisioning through GRID/XDE parallel processing to OutputHandler with GETAFE events and Redis state sync.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the Data Provisioning step do in XENA LaaS?')
sendPrompt('What is the XENA Input Bucket and how is it structured?')
sendPrompt('What does XENALoader do during payload enrichment?')
sendPrompt('What is the SQS GRID Connector Queue?')
sendPrompt('How does GRID/XDE process deals in parallel using Redis atomic counters?')
sendPrompt('How does NettingSet completion detection work in GRID/XDE?')
sendPrompt('What are _progress.json and manifest.json used for in XENA?')
sendPrompt('What is written to the S3 Output Bucket and how is it structured?')
sendPrompt('What does the XENA OutputHandler do?')
sendPrompt('What is Redis state sync in the OutputHandler?')
sendPrompt('What GETAFE events does OutputHandler emit?')
